notes: ASSUMPTIONS: (1) Aqua = rows with satellite=='Aqua' exactly in the modis zips; S-NPP = rows with satellite=='N' exactly in the viirs-snpp zips; daytime = daynight=='D' exactly; no other filter. (2) rows_read = every data row (header excluded) of every CSV member of the 14 modis zips and the 14 viirs-snpp zips, before any satellite/daynight filter (so modis includes Terra and night rows). (3) Every row is counted as it appears; rows are NOT de-duplicated across country files. (4) Days are assigned by the acq_date string; day 0 = 2012-01-01; month/year are the calendar month/year of acq_date; block = day // 16. (5) Cell edges: lon0 <= longitude < lon0+2 and lat0 <= latitude < lat0+2 on the float values as parsed. (6) Retained-day test uses whole-archive daytime counts of the same row sets as in (1). (7) Counts on non-retained days are set to zero everywhere (baseline, target, bootstrap). (8) aqua_count and snpp_count are over retained days of the target year. (9) Bootstrap: w = default_rng(20261114).poisson(1.0,(1000,320)) as the first draw; replicate L recomputed from weighted counts incl. the Vb[m]>0 fallback; non-finite L dropped; numpy.percentile linear. (10) Rounding with Python round() on the float64 result; JSON numbers drop trailing zeros, so e.g. 0.98 means 0.980 and 1.06 means 1.060. (11) Files for other years and viirs-jpss1 were not opened; the non-CSV readme member in each zip was skipped.
